cases.question: Tornado outbreak in Potter County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure — which hospitals and power substations fall within the highest-risk tornado zones in the county?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH potter_hexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE UPPER("County") LIKE '%POTTER%'
),
tornado_risk AS (
    SELECT 
        h.hex_id,
        t.nri_tornado
    FROM potter_hexes h
    JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
    WHERE t.nri_tornado IS NOT NULL
),
high_risk_hexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id, nri_tornado
    FROM tornado_risk
    WHERE nri_tornado >= (
        SELECT MAX(nri_tornado) * 0.9
        FROM tornado_risk
    )
)
SELECT 
    hr.hex_id,
    hr.nri_tornado,
    COALESCE(h."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) AS hospital_count,
    COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substation_count
FROM high_risk_hexes hr
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h ON hr.hex_id = h.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e ON hr.hex_id = e.hex_id
WHERE COALESCE(h."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) > 0 
   OR COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) > 0
ORDER BY hr.nri_tornado DESC;
```

cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH midland_hexes AS (
    SELECT hc."hex_id"
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
    WHERE hc."County" = 'Midland' AND hc."State" = 'TX'
),
tornado_risk AS (
    SELECT mh."hex_id", ht."nri_tornado"
    FROM midland_hexes mh
    JOIN "HP_TOR_001" ht ON mh."hex_id" = ht."hex_id"
),
high_risk_hexes AS (
    SELECT "hex_id"
    FROM tornado_risk
    WHERE "nri_tornado" > (
        SELECT AVG("nri_tornado")
        FROM tornado_risk
    )
),
hospital_data AS (
    SELECT hh."hex_id",
           CASE WHEN hh."hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_hospital
    FROM "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hh
    WHERE hh."hex_id" IN (SELECT "hex_id" FROM high_risk_hexes)
),
substation_data AS (
    SELECT es."hex_id",
           CASE WHEN es."hifld_energy_substations_n" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_substation
    FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" es
    WHERE es."hex_id" IN (SELECT "hex_id" FROM high_risk_hexes)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_risk_hexes) AS total_high_risk_hexes,
    (SELECT SUM(has_hospital) FROM hospital_data) AS high_risk_hexes_with_hospital,
    (SELECT SUM(has_substation) FROM substation_data) AS high_risk_hexes_with_substation,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_risk_hexes) - (SELECT SUM(has_hospital) FROM hospital_data) AS hospital_gap_hexes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM high_risk_hexes) - (SELECT SUM(has_substation) FROM substation_data) AS substation_gap_hexes
FROM (SELECT 1);
```

cases.question: Wildfire threatening Midland County. Identify the highest-risk fire zones and assess power infrastructure exposure. Does the county have sufficient first responder resources to cover the threatened area?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH midland_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE UPPER("County") LIKE '%MIDLAND%' AND UPPER("State") LIKE '%TEXAS%'
),
fire_risk_data AS (
    SELECT 
        m.hex_id,
        COALESCE(v."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) AS wildfire_eal,
        COALESCE(cfp."crown_fire_prob", 0) AS crown_fire_prob
    FROM midland_hexes m
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v ON m.hex_id = v.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "crown_fire_probability" cfp ON m.hex_id = cfp.hex_id
),
power_infra AS (
    SELECT 
        m.hex_id,
        COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substations_n,
        COALESCE(e2."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) AS energy_plants_n,
        COALESCE(e3."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) AS tx_lines_km
    FROM midland_hexes m
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e ON m.hex_id = e.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e2 ON m.hex_id = e2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON m.hex_id = e3.hex_id
),
first_responders AS (
    SELECT 
        m.hex_id,
        COALESCE(f."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) AS fire_ems_n,
        COALESCE(l."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n", 0) AS law_enforcement_n
    FROM midland_hexes m
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" f ON m.hex_id = f.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" l ON m.hex_id = l.hex_id
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.hex_id,
        fr.wildfire_eal,
        fr.crown_fire_prob,
        p.substations_n,
        p.energy_plants_n,
        p.tx_lines_km,
        r.fire_ems_n,
        r.law_enforcement_n,
        CASE 
            WHEN fr.wildfire_eal > (SELECT AVG(wildfire_eal) FROM fire_risk_data WHERE wildfire_eal > 0) 
                 OR fr.crown_fire_prob > 0.3 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS high_risk_flag
    FROM fire_risk_data fr
    LEFT JOIN power_infra p ON fr.hex_id = p.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN first_responders r ON fr.hex_id = r.hex_id
    WHERE fr.wildfire_eal > 0 OR fr.crown_fire_prob > 0
)
SELECT 
    'Midland County Wildfire Risk Assessment' AS analysis,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN hex_id END) AS high_risk_hexes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hex_id) AS total_risk_hexes,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN wildfire_eal ELSE 0 END), 4) AS high_risk_wildfire_eal,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN crown_fire_prob ELSE NULL END), 4) AS avg_high_risk_crown_fire_prob,
    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN substations_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_substations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN energy_plants_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_energy_plants,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN tx_lines_km ELSE 0 END), 4) AS high_risk_tx_lines_km,
    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_fire_ems_stations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN law_enforcement_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_law_enforcement,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) > 0 
             AND SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN law_enforcement_n ELSE 0 END) > 0 
        THEN 'First responders present in high-risk zones'
        ELSE 'No first responders in high-risk zones'
    END AS responder_coverage,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) >= 
             COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN hex_id END) 
        THEN 'Sufficient'
        ELSE 'Insufficient'
    END AS responder_sufficiency
FROM combined_data;
```

    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_fire_ems_stations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN law_enforcement_n ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_law_enforcement,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) > 0 
             AND SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN law_enforcement_n ELSE 0 END) > 0 
        THEN 'First responders present in high-risk zones'
        ELSE 'No first responders in high-risk zones'
    END AS responder_coverage,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN fire_ems_n ELSE 0 END) >= 
             COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN high_risk_flag = 1 THEN hex_id END) 
        THEN 'Sufficient'
        ELSE 'Insufficient'
    END AS responder_sufficiency
FROM combined_data;

cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH dallas_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "County" = 'Dallas' AND "State" = 'TX'
),
income_data AS (
    SELECT hex_id, inv_median_income
    FROM "VUL_001"
    WHERE hex_id IN (SELECT hex_id FROM dallas_hexes)
),
grid_vulnerability AS (
    SELECT 
        e.hex_id,
        COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) as substations_n,
        COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) as plants_n,
        COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) as tx_km
    FROM "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p ON e.hex_id = p.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" t ON e.hex_id = t.hex_id
    WHERE e.hex_id IN (SELECT hex_id FROM dallas_hexes)
),
flood_risk AS (
    SELECT hex_id, nri_coastal_flood, nri_riverine_flood
    FROM "HP_FLD_002"
    WHERE hex_id IN (SELECT hex_id FROM dallas_hexes)
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        dh.hex_id,
        i.inv_median_income,
        gv.substations_n,
        gv.plants_n,
        gv.tx_km,
        fr.nri_coastal_flood,
        fr.nri_riverine_flood,
        (i.inv_median_income * 0.4 + 
         (CASE WHEN gv.substations_n = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 0.3 +
         (COALESCE(fr.nri_riverine_flood, 0) + COALESCE(fr.nri_coastal_flood, 0)) * 0.3) as risk_score
    FROM dallas_hexes dh
    LEFT JOIN income_data i ON dh.hex_id = i.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN grid_vulnerability gv ON dh.hex_id = gv.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN flood_risk fr ON dh.hex_id = fr.hex_id
    WHERE i.inv_median_income IS NOT NULL
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(risk_score) as avg_risk,
        AVG(risk_score) + (AVG(risk_score * risk_score) - AVG(risk_score) * AVG(risk_score)) * 0.5 as risk_threshold,
        AVG(inv_median_income) as avg_income
    FROM combined_data
    WHERE risk_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(cd.inv_median_income), 4) as avg_inv_income,
    ROUND(AVG(cd.risk_score), 4) as avg_risk_score
FROM combined_data cd, risk_stats rs
WHERE cd.risk_score > rs.risk_threshold
AND cd.inv_median_income > rs.avg_income;
```

```sql
    FROM "VUL_003" v
    INNER JOIN denton_hexes d ON v.hex_id = d.hex_id
    WHERE v.nri_eala_TRND IS NOT NULL
),
high_risk_hexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id, eal_building_tornado
    FROM tornado_risk
    WHERE risk_percentile <= 0.1
)
SELECT

    ROUND(SUM(h.eal_building_tornado), 4) AS expected_annual_loss_tornado_building
FROM high_risk_hexes h
INNER JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON h.hex_id = b.hex_id;
```

```sql
WITH brazoria_hexes AS (
    SELECT "hex_id"
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "County" = 'Brazoria County'
),
flood_vul_join AS (
    SELECT 
        bh."hex_id",
        COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) AS flood_score,
        COALESCE(v."sovi", 0) AS sovi,
        COALESCE(p."population_7km", 0) AS population_7km
    FROM brazoria_hexes bh
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON bh."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v ON bh."hex_id" = v."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" p ON bh."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    WHERE (COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) > 0
),
priority_zones AS (
    SELECT 
        "hex_id",
        flood_score,
        sovi,
        (flood_score * sovi) AS priority_score,
        population_7km
    FROM flood_vul_join
    WHERE sovi > 0
    ORDER BY priority_score DESC

),
avg_pop_density AS (

    FROM flood_vul_join
)
SELECT 
    pz."hex_id",
    pz.flood_score,
    pz.sovi,
    pz.priority_score,
    apd.avg_population_density_in_flood_exposed
FROM priority_zones pz
CROSS JOIN avg_pop_density apd;
```

cases.question: Tornado warning in Tarrant County. Estimate the building stock at risk in the highest tornado exposure zones and quantify the expected economic losses.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH tarrant_hexes AS (
    SELECT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "County" = 'Tarrant' AND "State" = 'TX'
),
tornado_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        t.hex_id,
        h.nri_tornado,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY h.nri_tornado DESC) AS exposure_decile
    FROM tarrant_hexes t
    JOIN "HP_TOR_001" h ON t.hex_id = h.hex_id
    WHERE h.nri_tornado IS NOT NULL
),
highest_exposure AS (
    SELECT hex_id, nri_tornado
    FROM tornado_exposure
    WHERE exposure_decile = 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT he.hex_id) AS high_exposure_hex_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.building_count, 0)) AS total_buildings_at_risk,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(v.nri_eal_TRND, 0)), 4) AS total_expected_annual_loss_tornado
FROM highest_exposure he
LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON he.hex_id = b.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v ON he.hex_id = v.hex_id;
```

cases.question: Flooding in Bexar County. Which hospitals face risk of road isolation due to flood-compromised access? Identify hospital locations in the highest flood-risk areas.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
    c."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" AS hospital_access_score,
    f."nri_riverine_flood" AS riverine_flood_risk,
    f."nri_coastal_flood" AS coastal_flood_risk,
    r."road_crit_index" AS road_criticality_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.7 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.7 
        THEN 'High Flood Risk'
        WHEN f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.4 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.4 
        THEN 'Medium Flood Risk'
        ELSE 'Low Flood Risk'
    END AS flood_risk_category
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_001" cl ON c."hex_id" = cl."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" r ON c."hex_id" = r."hex_id"
WHERE c."County" = 'Bexar County'
    AND cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" > 0
    AND (f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.5 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.5)
    AND r."road_crit_index" < 0.3
ORDER BY 
    (COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0)) DESC,
    r."road_crit_index" ASC,
    cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" DESC;
```

cases.reforce_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    c."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" AS hospital_access_score,
    f."nri_riverine_flood" AS riverine_flood_risk,
    f."nri_coastal_flood" AS coastal_flood_risk,
    r."road_crit_index" AS road_criticality_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.7 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.7 
        THEN 'High Flood Risk'
        WHEN f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.4 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.4 
        THEN 'Medium Flood Risk'
        ELSE 'Low Flood Risk'
    END AS flood_risk_category
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_001" cl ON c."hex_id" = cl."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" r ON c."hex_id" = r."hex_id"
WHERE c."County" = 'Bexar County'
    AND cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" > 0
    AND (f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.5 OR f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.5)
    AND r."road_crit_index" < 0.3
ORDER BY 
    (COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0)) DESC,
    r."road_crit_index" ASC,
    cl."hex_fc_rac_hospital" DESC;

cases.question: Flooding in Wharton County. How does low elevation contribute to flood severity in low-lying areas? Identify the highest-priority SAR zones combining flood exposure and vulnerability.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    h."County",
    h."State",
    COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) AS "nri_coastal_flood",
    COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) AS "nri_riverine_flood",
    COALESCE(v2."sovi", 0) AS "sovi",
    COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 0) AS "psvi_score",
    (COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) * 
    (COALESCE(v2."sovi", 1) + COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 1)) AS "priority_score"
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON h."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON h."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
WHERE UPPER(h."County") LIKE '%WHARTON%'
    AND (COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) > 0)
ORDER BY "priority_score" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

SELECT 
```sql
    hc."hex_id",
    hc."County",
    hc."State",
    v2."sovi" AS social_vulnerability_index,
    v4."psvi_score" AS pandemic_social_vulnerability_index,
    fe."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n" AS fire_ems_stations_count,
    hf."nri_coastal_flood" AS coastal_flood_risk,
    hf."nri_riverine_flood" AS riverine_flood_risk,
    CASE 
        WHEN hf."nri_coastal_flood" > 0 OR hf."nri_riverine_flood" > 0 THEN 'Exposed'
        ELSE 'Not Exposed'
    END AS flood_exposure_status
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON hc."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON hc."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fe ON hc."hex_id" = fe."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" hf ON hc."hex_id" = hf."hex_id"
WHERE hc."County" = 'Hidalgo County' 
    AND fe."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n" > 0
    AND (hf."nri_coastal_flood" > 0 OR hf."nri_riverine_flood" > 0)
ORDER BY (hf."nri_coastal_flood" + hf."nri_riverine_flood") DESC, v2."sovi" DESC;
```

cases.question: Hurricane flooding in Chambers County. How does flood severity translate into building damage and economic losses? Query the knowledge graph and then estimate flood EAL for the most exposed areas.
cases.system_answer:

```sql
SELECT 
    c."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    b."building_count",
    f."nri_coastal_flood",
    f."nri_riverine_flood",
    v."nri_eal_CFLD" AS coastal_flood_eal,
    v."nri_eal_RFLD" AS riverine_flood_eal,
    (v."nri_eal_CFLD" + v."nri_eal_RFLD") AS total_flood_eal,
    ROUND((v."nri_eal_CFLD" + v."nri_eal_RFLD") / b."building_count", 4) AS eal_per_building

JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"

WHERE c."County" = 'Chambers County'
```

    c."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    b."building_count",
    f."nri_coastal_flood",
    f."nri_riverine_flood",
    v."nri_eal_CFLD" AS coastal_flood_eal,
    v."nri_eal_RFLD" AS riverine_flood_eal,
    (v."nri_eal_CFLD" + v."nri_eal_RFLD") AS total_flood_eal,
    ROUND((v."nri_eal_CFLD" + v."nri_eal_RFLD") / b."building_count", 4) AS eal_per_building
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
JOIN "VUL_003" v ON c."hex_id" = v."hex_id"
JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON c."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
WHERE c."County" = 'Chambers County'
  AND (v."nri_eal_CFLD" > 0 OR v."nri_eal_RFLD" > 0)
ORDER BY total_flood_eal DESC, (f."nri_coastal_flood" + f."nri_riverine_flood") DESC
LIMIT 20;

cases.question: Severe flooding in Montgomery County. How does runoff from the area's terrain amplify flood occurrence? Then identify priority SAR zones by combining flood exposure and social vulnerability.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    h."County",
    h."State",
    -- Flood exposure: sum of coastal and riverine flood risk
    COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) AS "flood_exposure",
```

```sql
WITH collin_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hc."hex_id"
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
    WHERE hc."County" = 'Collin' AND hc."State" = 'TX'
),
building_data AS (
    SELECT eb."hex_id", eb."building_count"
    FROM "EX_BLD_001" eb
    JOIN collin_hexes ch ON eb."hex_id" = ch."hex_id"

    JOIN collin_hexes ch ON ht."hex_id" = ch."hex_id"

flood_eal AS (
    SELECT v."hex_id", v."nri_eal_RFLD" AS flood_eal
    FROM "VUL_003" v
    JOIN collin_hexes ch ON v."hex_id" = ch."hex_id"
),
fire_stations AS (
    SELECT hf."hex_id", hf."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n" AS fire_station_count
    FROM "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" hf
    JOIN collin_hexes ch ON hf."hex_id" = ch."hex_id"
),
population_data AS (

    FROM "EX_POP_001" ep
    JOIN collin_hexes ch ON ep."hex_id" = ch."hex_id"

    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fs."fire_station_count" = 0 THEN bd."building_count" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS buildings_in_hexes_without_fire_stations
FROM collin_hexes ch
LEFT JOIN building_data bd ON ch."hex_id" = bd."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN tornado_risk tr ON ch."hex_id" = tr."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN flood_eal fe ON ch."hex_id" = fe."hex_id"

LEFT JOIN population_data pd ON ch."hex_id" = pd."hex_id";
```

```sql
WITH bell_county_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "County" = 'Bell County'
),
high_flood_risk_hexes AS (
    SELECT hf.hex_id
    FROM "HP_FLD_002" hf
    JOIN bell_county_hexes bch ON hf.hex_id = bch.hex_id
    WHERE (hf."nri_coastal_flood" >= 10 OR hf."nri_riverine_flood" >= 10)
),
infrastructure_in_flood_zones AS (
    SELECT 
        hf.hex_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(fire."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n"), 0) AS fire_ems_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(hosp."hifld_health_hospitals_n"), 0) AS hospital_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(shelter."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n"), 0) AS shelter_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(law."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n"), 0) AS law_enforcement_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(eoc_local."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n"), 0) AS local_eoc_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(eoc_state."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n"), 0) AS state_eoc_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(energy_plant."hifld_energy_plants_n"), 0) AS energy_plant_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(substation."hifld_energy_substations_n"), 0) AS substation_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(wtp."hifld_water_wtp_n"), 0) AS water_treatment_count
    FROM high_flood_risk_hexes hf
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fire ON hf.hex_id = fire.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hosp ON hf.hex_id = hosp.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" shelter ON hf.hex_id = shelter.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" law ON hf.hex_id = law.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" eoc_local ON hf.hex_id = eoc_local.hex_id

    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" energy_plant ON hf.hex_id = energy_plant.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" substation ON hf.hex_id = substation.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-WATER-WTP-N" wtp ON hf.hex_id = wtp.hex_id
    GROUP BY hf.hex_id
),
evacuation_route_viability AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.hex_id,
        rc."road_crit_index",
        CASE 
            WHEN rc."road_crit_index" >= 7.5 THEN 'High Criticality - Likely Open'
            WHEN rc."road_crit_index" >= 5.0 THEN 'Medium Criticality - Possibly Open'
            ELSE 'Low Criticality - Possibly Closed'
        END AS route_status
    FROM "TRANS-ROAD-CRIT-INDEX" rc
    JOIN bell_county_hexes bch ON rc.hex_id = bch.hex_id
    WHERE rc."road_crit_index" IS NOT NULL
)

    SUM(inf.substation_count) AS total_substations_in_flood_zones,
    SUM(inf.water_treatment_count) AS total_water_treatment_in_flood_zones
FROM evacuation_route_viability erv

WHERE erv.route_status IN ('High Criticality - Likely Open', 'Medium Criticality - Possibly Open');
```

The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH lubbock_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hc."hex_id"
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
    WHERE hc."County" LIKE '%Lubbock%'
),
tornado_risk AS (
    SELECT 
        lh."hex_id",
        ht."nri_tornado",
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ht."nri_tornado" DESC) AS risk_percentile
    FROM lubbock_hexes lh
    LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" ht ON lh."hex_id" = ht."hex_id"
    WHERE ht."nri_tornado" IS NOT NULL
),
high_risk_zones AS (
    SELECT "hex_id", "nri_tornado"
    FROM tornado_risk
    WHERE risk_percentile <= 0.25
),
critical_infra AS (
    SELECT 
        hrz."hex_id",
        hrz."nri_tornado",
        COALESCE(hh."hifld_health_hospitals_n", 0) AS hospitals,
        COALESCE(he."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substations,
        COALESCE(hf."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n", 0) AS first_responders
    FROM high_risk_zones hrz
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hh ON hrz."hex_id" = hh."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" he ON hrz."hex_id" = he."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" hf ON hrz."hex_id" = hf."hex_id"
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT "hex_id") AS high_risk_hexes,
        SUM(hospitals) AS total_hospitals,
        SUM(substations) AS total_substations,
        SUM(first_responders) AS total_first_responders,
        SUM(hospitals + substations) AS total_critical_facilities
    FROM critical_infra
)
SELECT 
    high_risk_hexes,
    total_hospitals,
    total_substations,
    total_critical_facilities,
    total_first_responders,
    (total_critical_facilities - total_first_responders) AS resource_gap,
    CASE 
        WHEN total_first_responders = 0 THEN 'Infinite gap (no responders)'
        WHEN total_critical_facilities = 0 THEN 'No critical facilities'
        WHEN total_first_responders >= total_critical_facilities THEN 'Sufficient capacity'
        ELSE 'Insufficient capacity'
    END AS gap_assessment
FROM totals;
```

The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH chambers_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hex_id
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "County" = 'Chambers County'
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ch.hex_id,
        -- Surge exposure
        COALESCE(hh2.ve_ae_fraction, 0) AS surge_exposure,
        -- Community resilience (inverse of vulnerability)
        COALESCE(v2.sovi, 0) AS social_vulnerability,
        COALESCE(cr.nri_cri_score, 0) AS resilience_score,
        -- Shelter locations
        COALESCE(sh."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n", 0) AS shelter_count,
        -- Additional recovery factors
        COALESCE(hp1.hurr_strike_rate_10y, 0) AS hurricane_strike_rate,
        COALESCE(v3.nri_eal_HRCN, 0) AS expected_annual_loss_hurricane,
        COALESCE(v1.inv_median_income, 0) AS inverse_median_income
    FROM chambers_hexes ch
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" hh2 ON ch.hex_id = hh2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON ch.hex_id = v2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "CR_001" cr ON ch.hex_id = cr.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" sh ON ch.hex_id = sh.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" hp1 ON ch.hex_id = hp1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON ch.hex_id = v3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_001" v1 ON ch.hex_id = v1.hex_id
),
prioritization AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        surge_exposure,
        social_vulnerability,
        resilience_score,
        shelter_count,
        hurricane_strike_rate,
        expected_annual_loss_hurricane,
        inverse_median_income,
        -- Priority score: higher surge exposure + higher vulnerability + lower resilience = higher priority
        (surge_exposure * 0.4 + social_vulnerability * 0.3 + (1 - resilience_score) * 0.3) AS priority_score
    FROM combined_data
)
SELECT 
    hex_id,
    ROUND(surge_exposure, 4) AS surge_exposure,
    ROUND(social_vulnerability, 4) AS social_vulnerability,
    ROUND(resilience_score, 4) AS resilience_score,
    shelter_count,
    ROUND(hurricane_strike_rate, 4) AS hurricane_strike_rate,
    ROUND(expected_annual_loss_hurricane, 4) AS expected_annual_loss_hurricane,
    ROUND(inverse_median_income, 4) AS inverse_median_income,
    ROUND(priority_score, 4) AS priority_score,
    -- Recovery sequencing: rank by priority_score descending (highest priority first)
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY priority_score DESC) AS recovery_sequence,
    -- Shelter viability: at least one shelter makes it viable
    CASE WHEN shelter_count > 0 THEN 'Viable' ELSE 'Not Viable' END AS shelter_viability
FROM prioritization
ORDER BY recovery_sequence;
```

    FROM chambers_hexes ch

    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON ch.hex_id = v3.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_001" v1 ON ch.hex_id = v1.hex_id
),
prioritization AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        surge_exposure,
        social_vulnerability,
        resilience_score,
        shelter_count,
        hurricane_strike_rate,
        expected_annual_loss_hurricane,
        inverse_median_income,
        -- Priority score: higher surge exposure + higher vulnerability + lower resilience = higher priority
        (surge_exposure * 0.4 + social_vulnerability * 0.3 + (1 - resilience_score) * 0.3) AS priority_score
    FROM combined_data
)
SELECT 
    hex_id,
    ROUND(surge_exposure, 4) AS surge_exposure,
    ROUND(social_vulnerability, 4) AS social_vulnerability,
    ROUND(resilience_score, 4) AS resilience_score,

    ROUND(inverse_median_income, 4) AS inverse_median_income,

    -- Recovery sequencing: rank by priority_score descending (highest priority first)
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY priority_score DESC) AS recovery_sequence,

FROM prioritization

cases.question: Hurricane in Nueces County. Query FEMA base flood elevation data and storm surge depth grids to assess which roads will be inundated, then estimate power outage extent.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    hc."hex_id",
    hc."County",
    hc."State",
    -- Flood risk data
    COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) AS coastal_flood_risk,
    COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) AS riverine_flood_risk,
    -- Hurricane risk data
    COALESCE(hh."hurr_strike_rate_10y", 0) AS hurricane_strike_rate,
    -- Road infrastructure
    COALESCE(ht."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) AS primary_roads_km,
    -- Building exposure
    COALESCE(eb."building_count", 0) AS building_count,
    -- Power infrastructure
    COALESCE(he_sub."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substation_count,
    -- Calculate estimated inundation and outages
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) > 0 
        THEN (COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) * 
             COALESCE(ht."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) / 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS estimated_roads_inundated_km,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) > 0 
        THEN (COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) * 
             COALESCE(eb."building_count", 0) / 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS estimated_buildings_affected
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" hp ON hc."hex_id" = hp."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" hh ON hc."hex_id" = hh."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-TRANSP-PRIMARY_RD-L" ht ON hc."hex_id" = ht."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" eb ON hc."hex_id" = eb."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" he_sub ON hc."hex_id" = he_sub."hex_id"
WHERE hc."County" LIKE '%Nueces%' 
    OR hc."County" LIKE '%NUECES%'
    OR hc."County" LIKE '%nueces%'
ORDER BY hc."hex_id";
```

cases.reforce_sql:
SELECT 
    hc."hex_id",
    hc."County",
    hc."State",
    -- Flood risk data
    COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) AS coastal_flood_risk,
    COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) AS riverine_flood_risk,
    -- Hurricane risk data
    COALESCE(hh."hurr_strike_rate_10y", 0) AS hurricane_strike_rate,
    -- Road infrastructure
    COALESCE(ht."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) AS primary_roads_km,
    -- Building exposure
    COALESCE(eb."building_count", 0) AS building_count,
    -- Power infrastructure
    COALESCE(he_sub."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substation_count,
    -- Calculate estimated inundation and outages
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) > 0 
        THEN (COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) * 
             COALESCE(ht."hifld_primary_roads_km", 0) / 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS estimated_roads_inundated_km,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0) > 0 
        THEN (COALESCE(hp."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(hp."nri_riverine_flood", 0)) * 
             COALESCE(eb."building_count", 0) / 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS estimated_buildings_affected
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" hc
LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" hp ON hc."hex_id" = hp."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" hh ON hc."hex_id" = hh."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-TRANSP-PRIMARY_RD-L" ht ON hc."hex_id" = ht."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" eb ON hc."hex_id" = eb."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" he_sub ON hc."hex_id" = he_sub."hex_id"
WHERE hc."County" LIKE '%Nueces%' 
    OR hc."County" LIKE '%NUECES%'
    OR hc."County" LIKE '%nueces%'
ORDER BY hc."hex_id";

```sql
JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON c."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON c."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
WHERE c."County" = 'Tom Green County'
```

The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH texas_hexes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "hex_id"
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk"
    WHERE "State" = 'Texas'
),
hospital_locations AS (
    SELECT "hex_id", "hifld_health_hospitals_n" as hospital_count
    FROM "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N"
    WHERE "hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
),
energy_vulnerability AS (
    SELECT 
        h."hex_id",
        COALESCE(p."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) as power_plants,
        COALESCE(s."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) as substations,
        COALESCE(t."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) as transmission_km,
        COALESCE(b."building_count", 0) as building_count,
        COALESCE(b2."hEE", 0) as hex_exposure,
        COALESCE(hp."hurr_strike_rate_10y", 0) as hurricane_strike_rate,
        COALESCE(hp2."ve_ae_fraction", 0) as wind_exposure,
        COALESCE(f."nri_coastal_flood", 0) + COALESCE(f."nri_riverine_flood", 0) as flood_risk
    FROM texas_hexes h
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" p ON h."hex_id" = p."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON h."hex_id" = s."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" t ON h."hex_id" = t."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" b ON h."hex_id" = b."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_002" b2 ON h."hex_id" = b2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_001" hp ON h."hex_id" = hp."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" hp2 ON h."hex_id" = hp2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h."hex_id" = f."hex_id"
),
power_vulnerability_score AS (
    SELECT 
        "hex_id",
        (COALESCE(power_plants, 0) * 0.2 + 
         COALESCE(substations, 0) * 0.3 + 
         COALESCE(transmission_km, 0) * 0.1 +
         COALESCE(building_count, 0) * 0.05 +
         COALESCE(hex_exposure, 0) * 0.05 +
         COALESCE(hurricane_strike_rate, 0) * 0.15 +
         COALESCE(wind_exposure, 0) * 0.1 +
         COALESCE(flood_risk, 0) * 0.05) as power_vuln_score
    FROM energy_vulnerability
),
percentile_calc AS (
    SELECT power_vuln_score
    FROM power_vulnerability_score
    ORDER BY power_vuln_score
    LIMIT 1
    OFFSET (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 0.75 AS INTEGER) FROM power_vulnerability_score) - 1
),
high_vulnerability_zones AS (
    SELECT pvs."hex_id", pvs.power_vuln_score
    FROM power_vulnerability_score pvs
    CROSS JOIN percentile_calc pc
    WHERE pvs.power_vuln_score >= pc.power_vuln_score
)
SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    h.hospital_count,
    ROUND(hv.power_vuln_score, 4) as power_vuln_score,
    c."County",
    c."Zipcode"
FROM hospital_locations h
JOIN high_vulnerability_zones hv ON h."hex_id" = hv."hex_id"
JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c ON h."hex_id" = c."hex_id"
WHERE c."State" = 'Texas'
ORDER BY hv.power_vuln_score DESC, h.hospital_count DESC;
```

```sql
  AND rh.health_rank <= rh.total_count * 0.1  -- Top 10% for health burden
ORDER BY avg_percentile_rank ASC
```

cases.question: Hurricane-season onset threatens the Texas-Mexico border region (El Paso, Hudspeth, Culberson, Presidio, Brewster, Terrell, Val Verde). Assess disaster preparedness capacity across these rural counties.
A prolonged grid outage is threatening rural Texas. Identify hospitals outside major metros that are in high power-vulnerability zones — facilities most at risk during extended outages.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" AS hospital_count,
    COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substations_n,
    COALESCE(e2."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) AS energy_plants_n,
    COALESCE(e3."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) AS high_voltage_tx_km,
    cr."nri_cri_score" AS criticality_score,
    cr."nri_cri_value" AS criticality_value
FROM "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h
JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c ON h."hex_id" = c."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e ON h."hex_id" = e."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e2 ON h."hex_id" = e2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON h."hex_id" = e3."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CR_001" cr ON h."hex_id" = cr."hex_id"
WHERE c."State" = 'Texas'
    AND h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
    AND c."County" NOT IN (
        'Harris', 'Dallas', 'Tarrant', 'Bexar', 'Travis', 
        'El Paso', 'Collin', 'Denton', 'Hidalgo', 'Fort Bend'
    )
ORDER BY 
    (COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
     COALESCE(e2."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
     COALESCE(e3."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0)) DESC,
    cr."nri_cri_score" DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

cases.reforce_sql:
SELECT 
    h."hex_id",
    c."County",
    c."State",
    h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" AS hospital_count,
    COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) AS substations_n,
    COALESCE(e2."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) AS energy_plants_n,
    COALESCE(e3."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0) AS high_voltage_tx_km,
    cr."nri_cri_score" AS criticality_score,
    cr."nri_cri_value" AS criticality_value
FROM "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h
JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c ON h."hex_id" = c."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e ON h."hex_id" = e."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e2 ON h."hex_id" = e2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON h."hex_id" = e3."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CR_001" cr ON h."hex_id" = cr."hex_id"
WHERE c."State" = 'Texas'
    AND h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
    AND c."County" NOT IN (
        'Harris', 'Dallas', 'Tarrant', 'Bexar', 'Travis', 
        'El Paso', 'Collin', 'Denton', 'Hidalgo', 'Fort Bend'
    )
ORDER BY 
    (COALESCE(e."hifld_energy_substations_n", 0) + 
     COALESCE(e2."hifld_energy_plants_n", 0) + 
     COALESCE(e3."hifld_energy_tx_km_230p", 0)) DESC,
    cr."nri_cri_score" DESC
LIMIT 50;

```sql
WITH hazard_data AS (
    SELECT 
        h.hex_id,
        COALESCE(h.hurr_strike_rate_10y, 0) AS hurr_strike,
        COALESCE(f.nri_coastal_flood, 0) AS coastal_flood,
        COALESCE(f.nri_riverine_flood, 0) AS river_flood,
        COALESCE(t.nri_tornado, 0) AS tornado_risk,
        COALESCE(c.crown_fire_prob, 0) AS fire_prob,
        COALESCE(h2.ve_ae_fraction, 0) AS wind_exp
    FROM "HP_HUR_001" h
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h.hex_id = f.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "crown_fire_probability" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" h2 ON h.hex_id = h2.hex_id
),
normalized_hazard AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        (hurr_strike - MIN(hurr_strike) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(hurr_strike) OVER () - MIN(hurr_strike) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_hurr,
        (coastal_flood - MIN(coastal_flood) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(coastal_flood) OVER () - MIN(coastal_flood) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_cflood,
        (river_flood - MIN(river_flood) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(river_flood) OVER () - MIN(river_flood) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_rflood,
        (tornado_risk - MIN(tornado_risk) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(tornado_risk) OVER () - MIN(tornado_risk) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_tornado,
        (fire_prob - MIN(fire_prob) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(fire_prob) OVER () - MIN(fire_prob) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_fire,
        (wind_exp - MIN(wind_exp) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(wind_exp) OVER () - MIN(wind_exp) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_wind
    FROM hazard_data
),
hazard_score AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        (COALESCE(norm_hurr, 0) + COALESCE(norm_cflood, 0) + COALESCE(norm_rflood, 0) + 
         COALESCE(norm_tornado, 0) + COALESCE(norm_fire, 0) + COALESCE(norm_wind, 0)) / 6.0 AS hazard_index
    FROM normalized_hazard
),
vuln_score AS (
    SELECT 
        v.hex_id,
        (COALESCE(v2.sovi, 0) - MIN(v2.sovi) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v2.sovi) OVER () - MIN(v2.sovi) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_sovi,
        (COALESCE(v4.psvi_score, 0) - MIN(v4.psvi_score) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v4.psvi_score) OVER () - MIN(v4.psvi_score) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_psvi,
        (COALESCE(v.inv_median_income, 0) - MIN(v.inv_median_income) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v.inv_median_income) OVER () - MIN(v.inv_median_income) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_inv_income
    FROM "VUL_001" v
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON v.hex_id = v2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON v.hex_id = v4.hex_id
),
resilience_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.hex_id,
        COALESCE(cr.nri_cri_score, 0) AS resilience_score,
        COALESCE(cl1.hex_fc_rac_hospital, 0) AS hospital_access,
        COALESCE(cl1.hex_fc_rac_grocery, 0) AS grocery_access,
        COALESCE(cl3.conc_index_hospital, 0) AS hospital_conc,
        COALESCE(cl3.conc_index_grocery, 0) AS grocery_conc
    FROM "CR_001" cr
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_001" cl1 ON cr.hex_id = cl1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_003" cl3 ON cr.hex_id = cl3.hex_id
),
exposure_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pop.hex_id,
        COALESCE(pop.population_7km, 0) AS pop,
        COALESCE(bld.building_count, 0) AS bld_count
    FROM "EX_POP_001" pop
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" bld ON pop.hex_id = bld.hex_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.hex_id,
        hs.hazard_index,
        (vs.norm_sovi + vs.norm_psvi + vs.norm_inv_income) / 3.0 AS vulnerability_index,
        1.0 - (rd.resilience_score - MIN(rd.resilience_score) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(rd.resilience_score) OVER () - MIN(rd.resilience_score) OVER ()), 0) AS resilience_deficit,
        rd.hospital_access,
        rd.grocery_access,
        rd.hospital_conc,
        rd.grocery_conc,
        ed.pop,
        ed.bld_count
    FROM hazard_score hs
    JOIN vuln_score vs ON hs.hex_id = vs.hex_id
    JOIN resilience_data rd ON hs.hex_id = rd.hex_id
    JOIN exposure_data ed ON hs.hex_id = ed.hex_id
    WHERE ed.pop > 0
),
final_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.hex_id,
        cs.hazard_index,
        cs.vulnerability_index,
        cs.resilience_deficit,
        cs.hospital_access,
        cs.grocery_access,
        cs.hospital_conc,
        cs.grocery_conc,
        cs.pop,
        cs.bld_count,
        cw.County,
        cw.State,
        (cs.hazard_index * cs.vulnerability_index * cs.resilience_deficit) AS compound_risk_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN cs.hospital_access < 0.5 AND cs.grocery_access < 0.5 THEN 'Critical Life Services'
            WHEN cs.hospital_conc > 0.7 OR cs.grocery_conc > 0.7 THEN 'Concentration Risk'
            WHEN cs.resilience_deficit > 0.7 THEN 'Resilience Building'
            ELSE 'Multi-Hazard Mitigation'
        END AS investment_priority
    FROM combined_scores cs
    LEFT JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" cw ON cs.hex_id = cw.hex_id
    WHERE cw.State IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    hex_id,
    County,
    State,
    ROUND(compound_risk_score, 4) AS compound_risk_score,
    ROUND(hazard_index, 4) AS hazard_index,
    ROUND(vulnerability_index, 4) AS vulnerability_index,
    ROUND(resilience_deficit, 4) AS resilience_deficit,
    ROUND(hospital_access, 4) AS hospital_access,
    ROUND(grocery_access, 4) AS grocery_access,
    investment_priority
FROM final_ranking
ORDER BY compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

    FROM "HP_HUR_001" h
    LEFT JOIN "HP_FLD_002" f ON h.hex_id = f.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HP_TOR_001" t ON h.hex_id = t.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "crown_fire_probability" c ON h.hex_id = c.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "HP_HUR_002" h2 ON h.hex_id = h2.hex_id
),
normalized_hazard AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        (hurr_strike - MIN(hurr_strike) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(hurr_strike) OVER () - MIN(hurr_strike) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_hurr,
        (coastal_flood - MIN(coastal_flood) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(coastal_flood) OVER () - MIN(coastal_flood) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_cflood,
        (river_flood - MIN(river_flood) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(river_flood) OVER () - MIN(river_flood) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_rflood,
        (tornado_risk - MIN(tornado_risk) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(tornado_risk) OVER () - MIN(tornado_risk) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_tornado,
        (fire_prob - MIN(fire_prob) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(fire_prob) OVER () - MIN(fire_prob) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_fire,
        (wind_exp - MIN(wind_exp) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(wind_exp) OVER () - MIN(wind_exp) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_wind
    FROM hazard_data
),
hazard_score AS (
    SELECT 
        hex_id,
        (COALESCE(norm_hurr, 0) + COALESCE(norm_cflood, 0) + COALESCE(norm_rflood, 0) + 
         COALESCE(norm_tornado, 0) + COALESCE(norm_fire, 0) + COALESCE(norm_wind, 0)) / 6.0 AS hazard_index
    FROM normalized_hazard
),
vuln_score AS (
    SELECT 
        v.hex_id,
        (COALESCE(v2.sovi, 0) - MIN(v2.sovi) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v2.sovi) OVER () - MIN(v2.sovi) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_sovi,
        (COALESCE(v4.psvi_score, 0) - MIN(v4.psvi_score) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v4.psvi_score) OVER () - MIN(v4.psvi_score) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_psvi,
        (COALESCE(v.inv_median_income, 0) - MIN(v.inv_median_income) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(v.inv_median_income) OVER () - MIN(v.inv_median_income) OVER ()), 0) AS norm_inv_income
    FROM "VUL_001" v
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON v.hex_id = v2.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON v.hex_id = v4.hex_id
),
resilience_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.hex_id,
        COALESCE(cr.nri_cri_score, 0) AS resilience_score,
        COALESCE(cl1.hex_fc_rac_hospital, 0) AS hospital_access,
        COALESCE(cl1.hex_fc_rac_grocery, 0) AS grocery_access,
        COALESCE(cl3.conc_index_hospital, 0) AS hospital_conc,
        COALESCE(cl3.conc_index_grocery, 0) AS grocery_conc
    FROM "CR_001" cr
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_001" cl1 ON cr.hex_id = cl1.hex_id
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_003" cl3 ON cr.hex_id = cl3.hex_id
),
exposure_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pop.hex_id,
        COALESCE(pop.population_7km, 0) AS pop,
        COALESCE(bld.building_count, 0) AS bld_count
    FROM "EX_POP_001" pop
    LEFT JOIN "EX_BLD_001" bld ON pop.hex_id = bld.hex_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        hs.hex_id,
        hs.hazard_index,
        (vs.norm_sovi + vs.norm_psvi + vs.norm_inv_income) / 3.0 AS vulnerability_index,
        1.0 - (rd.resilience_score - MIN(rd.resilience_score) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(rd.resilience_score) OVER () - MIN(rd.resilience_score) OVER ()), 0) AS resilience_deficit,
        rd.hospital_access,
        rd.grocery_access,
        rd.hospital_conc,
        rd.grocery_conc,
        ed.pop,
        ed.bld_count
    FROM hazard_score hs
    JOIN vuln_score vs ON hs.hex_id = vs.hex_id
    JOIN resilience_data rd ON hs.hex_id = rd.hex_id
    JOIN exposure_data ed ON hs.hex_id = ed.hex_id
    WHERE ed.pop > 0
),
final_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.hex_id,
        cs.hazard_index,
        cs.vulnerability_index,
        cs.resilience_deficit,
        cs.hospital_access,
        cs.grocery_access,
        cs.hospital_conc,
        cs.grocery_conc,
        cs.pop,
        cs.bld_count,
        cw.County,
        cw.State,
        (cs.hazard_index * cs.vulnerability_index * cs.resilience_deficit) AS compound_risk_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN cs.hospital_access < 0.5 AND cs.grocery_access < 0.5 THEN 'Critical Life Services'
            WHEN cs.hospital_conc > 0.7 OR cs.grocery_conc > 0.7 THEN 'Concentration Risk'
            WHEN cs.resilience_deficit > 0.7 THEN 'Resilience Building'
            ELSE 'Multi-Hazard Mitigation'
        END AS investment_priority
    FROM combined_scores cs
    LEFT JOIN "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" cw ON cs.hex_id = cw.hex_id
    WHERE cw.State IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    hex_id,
    County,
    State,
    ROUND(compound_risk_score, 4) AS compound_risk_score,
    ROUND(hazard_index, 4) AS hazard_index,
    ROUND(vulnerability_index, 4) AS vulnerability_index,
    ROUND(resilience_deficit, 4) AS resilience_deficit,
    ROUND(hospital_access, 4) AS hospital_access,
    ROUND(grocery_access, 4) AS grocery_access,
    investment_priority
FROM final_ranking
ORDER BY compound_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
